summary: Quests: authored stage machines whose transitions are triggers, with each quest's current stage and objective text in the snapshot

coordination.notes: Implemented -- the last of the four reserved keys. A quest is data (a stage machine: displayName, initialStage, a keyed stages map with objective text and an optional terminal outcome) plus one new closed trigger effect, SetQuestStage, that is the only thing that moves it: completion and failure are effects, exactly as the contract stated, not a second mechanism this lane had to invent. SetQuestStage refuses to move a quest to the stage it is already on and refuses to move it out of a terminal stage, so a quest settles exactly once per outcome. quest_stages (quest id to current stage id) is play state on FactionWorld, seeded from every declared quest's initialStage in from_scenario (and, for the fixture that builds a FactionWorld by hand rather than through from_scenario, seeded the same way at that call site), and saved/refused by name (invalid_saved_quest_stages) if a save is missing a declared quest's entry, carries an entry for an undeclared quest, or names a stage that quest does not define. A version-1 save migrating into a scenario is seeded identically at migration time. The validator proves every quest has a reachable initial stage, at least one terminal stage, and every other stage reached by some set_quest_stage effect in the pack, all failing by name. The main pack's one quest (quest.the_cult_beneath_the_water) is wired onto the two triggers that already existed, closing the loop from heat through diplomacy to a visible campaign outcome.
